pr_title: Fix arrow conversion, map doesn't support large offset

issue_context.title: Bug in map to Arrow conversion.
issue_context.body:
### What happens?

When `arrow_large_buffer_size` is enabled, conversion of map data type to Arrow results in incorrect data. It looks like DuckDB uses 64-bit offsets when generating Arrow MapArray, but MapArray only supports 32-bit offsets. There is no LargeMapArray type in Arrow.

### To Reproduce

```
import duckdb

# correct
arrow = duckdb.sql("select map(['non-inlined string', 'test', 'duckdb'], [42, 1337, 123])").to_arrow_table()
print(arrow)

# incorrect
duckdb.sql("set arrow_large_buffer_size=true")
arrow = duckdb.sql("select map(['non-inlined string', 'test', 'duckdb'], [42, 1337, 123])").to_arrow_table()
print(arrow)
```

```
pyarrow.Table
map(main.list_value('non-inlined string', 'test', 'duckdb'), main.list_value(42, 1337, 123)): map<string, int32>
  child 0, entries: struct<key: string not null, value: int32> not null
      child 0, key: string not null
      child 1, value: int32
----
map(main.list_value('non-inlined string', 'test', 'duckdb'), main.list_value(42, 1337, 123)): [[keys:["non-inlined string","test","duckdb"]values:[42,1337,123]]
```
```
pyarrow.Table
map(main.list_value('non-inlined string', 'test', 'duckdb'), main.list_value(42, 1337, 123)): map<large_string, int32>
  child 0, entries: struct<key: large_string not null, value: int32> not null
      child 0, key: large_string not null
      child 1, value: int32
----
map(main.list_value('non-inlined string', 'test', 'duckdb'), main.list_value(42, 1337, 123)): [[keys:[]values:[]]]
```
